static_traits.name: Lin Kexin
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, living with a pet cat
static_traits.social_status: Preferring Being alone, reduced contact with friends due to financial pressure; has one friend to confide in, but has not yet shared financial worries
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; has not yet received psychotherapy in the past; no similar financial-problem history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly cooperative, neutral tone, able to describe problems and trigger situations specifically

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I will be poor for the rest of my life because my income as a cafe waiter is not high.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to find a higher-paying Work, improve financial stability, and ease ongoing worries about future finances.
growth_experiences: Directly entered the food service industry after High school graduation, working as a waiter in a cafe; financial insecurity appeared when seeing the first few pay slips after starting the job and continued to worsen; has been working the same position without yet seeing financial improvement; Anxiety intensified every payday or when thinking about future financial stability; reduced socializing with friends due to financial pressure, Sleep affected; Living alone, living with a pet cat; no psychotherapy history in the past, No major physical illness.

core_beliefs: I am destined to stay poor
I have no ability to improve my financial and career situation

special_situations.event: Each time receiving pay or checking the pay stub
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my current income is low, it means I will also be poor in the future, unable to improve
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing financial problems with friends, continuing job hunting only in familiar catering roles
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This money will never be enough; I will always be poor.

special_situations.event: Thinking about my future financial stability or Career development
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no progress now, there will not be any change in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not setting specific goals, sinking into worry and insomnia, Reduced socializing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never get rid of poverty.

special_situations.event: Searching for higher-paying Work without results (job search failure)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not have more qualifications, I cannot find better Work; failure shows I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continues job hunting in familiar cafe/restaurant positions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not qualified; I am not capable.

special_situations.event: Focusing attention on the negative aspect of insufficient income when evaluating current Work and life situation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only income determines my value and future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or devalues existing resources (such as friends' support, interest in animals) and potential options
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The only thing in my life is low pay; nothing else matters.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain a stable, safe and supported life (economic security)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing long-term poverty and failure, being trapped and unable to change
defense_goal: Reducing disappointment and Anxiety by keeping low-risk choices and realistic Interpretation
Reducing emotional exposure and seeking help from others, to lower inner tension and uncertainty

object_relations.self_representation: I am an unqualified person who finds it hard to improve
object_relations.object_representation: Others/the environment are restrictive, unlikely to provide help or opportunities

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to set goals or explore new career directions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to believe 'even setting goals is meaningless; I cannot change', to reduce Anxiety in facing uncertainty
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing doubt in a gentle but reserved tone, e.g. 'setting goals probably will not make any difference', avoiding deep emotional levels, only stating practical difficulties.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether one shares financial worries with friends and seeks support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing 'I should not bother others now; I should carry it myself', to avoid the uncertainty and embarrassment brought by outside involvement
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gives explanations mainly in terms of objective facts and practical obstacles, downplaying or avoiding expressing vulnerable emotions and needs for help.

manifestations: Feels bound by low income and limited qualifications, career choices are limited to the familiar catering industry
Describes being 'stuck', hard to move toward a better job and life
Living alone and preferring Being alone
Having friends to confide in but not yet sharing financial worries, keeping distance
outcomes: Growing sense of pressure and long-term worry

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the behavioral impulse originally intended toward others or the environment, instead does it to himself, or transfers what needs to be done by the outside world to be borne by himself.
manifestations: Not yet sharing financial troubles with friends, turning the urge to seek help back onto bearing it alone
Choosing Being alone rather than seeking support under high pressure

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-Reflection and self-limitation, excessive self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Believing oneself 'not qualified enough', limiting cross-field job attempts
Being skeptical about setting goals, tending to negate one's own possibilities first

positive_force: Has willingness to act (actively looking for work)
Stable interest in animals, willing to explore animal-related career directions
Has a friend to confide in (a potential support resource)
negative_force: Strong negative cognitive patterns of catastrophizing, overgeneralization and predicting the future
Social withdrawal and not sharing difficulties, insufficient external support
Limited qualifications and a narrow job-search range
Financial Anxiety leading to Sleep disturbance and Decline in work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent catastrophic worry and negative automatic thoughts about financial status
antecedent: When receiving pay or checking the pay slip
Job search failure or thinking of one's inadequate qualifications
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic Interpretation of insufficient income and negative predictions about the future ('I will always be poor')
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncertainty and providing Rationalization for low-risk choices, briefly reducing Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety intensified, Sleep affected, Decline in work performance, further limiting career exploration

antecedent: When feeling financial pressure or thinking about money issues
When facing opportunities to interact with friends
target_behavior.core_reason: Unwilling to talk about financial difficulties, tending to bear pressure alone
target_behavior.function: Briefly reducing emotional exposure and the discomfort brought by talking about money
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support, worsened sense of Loneliness and helplessness, pressure maintained or worsened
